category.cgg.title: Custom Game GUI
cgg.gui.title: Custom Game GUI Settings
cgg.gui.enabled.desc: Master switch for Custom Game GUI modifications.
cgg.gui.hide_experience_bar.desc: Hides the experience bar above the hotbar.
cgg.gui.shift_down_without_exp_bar.desc: Shifts hearts, hunger, armor, air, saturation and level down towards hotbar when XP bar is hidden.
cgg.gui.shift_exp_level.desc: Lowers the level number when XP bar is hidden so it rests right above the hotbar.
cgg.gui.hide_health_bar.desc: Hides player health hearts and absorption.
cgg.gui.hide_armor_bar.desc: Hides the armor bar above health.
cgg.gui.hide_air_bar.desc: Hides the underwater air bubble meter.
cgg.gui.show_saturation_bar.desc: Renders a golden saturation bar above the hunger bar.
cgg.gui.saturation_preview_food.desc: Shows flashing hunger restoration and saturation preview when holding food items.
cgg.gui.appleskin_integration.desc: Enables seamless compatibility and sync with AppleSkin mod.
cgg.gui.appleskin_hide_default_sat.desc: Suppresses AppleSkin's saturation flash on hunger bar to use CGG's dedicated Saturation Bar.
cgg.gui.hotbar_bg_opacity.desc: Adjusts the opacity/transparency of the hotbar slots background.
cgg.gui.hotbar_selection_opacity.desc: Adjusts the opacity/transparency of the selected item slot frame.
cgg.gui.hide_held_item_name.desc: Hides the popup text of the selected item above the hotbar.
cgg.gui.hide_crosshair.desc: Hides the center crosshair in the screen.
cgg.gui.hide_boss_bar.desc: Hides boss health bars at the top of the screen.
cgg.gui.hide_status_effects.desc: Hides potion effect icons in the top-right corner.
cgg.gui.hide_vignette.desc: Disables dark vignette shadows on the edges of the screen.
cgg.gui.status_bar_offset.desc: Vertical pixel offset used when shifting status bars down (Default: 6px).
